raw_text:
1. This Act may be cited as the Bank of Ceylon
Shor
title.
(Amendment) Act, No. 60 of 1980.

2. Section 7 of the Bank of Ceylon Ordinance (herein-
after referred to as the "principal enactment"), as amended
by Law No. 10 of 1974, is hereby repealed and the following
Replacement
of section 7
of
Chapter 397.
new section substituted therefor:-
"Capital.
7. (1) The authorized capital of the bank
shall be one thousand million rupees divided
into one million shares of one thousand
rupees each.
(2) The paid-up capital of the bank shall
be such amount as may be determined from
time to time by the Minister by Order
published in the Gazette.
(3) The liability of the Government at
any time as sole shareholder shall be limited
to the total amount of the capital represented
by the shares held for the time being by the
Government. ".

3. Section 33 of the principal enactment as amended by
Law No. 10 of 1974, is hereby repealed and the following
Replacement
of section S
of the
principal
enactment.
Full
new section substituted therefor:-
33. The Minister may from time to time
"Minister
to give
directions.
give general or special directions in writing
to the Board as to the performance of the
duties and the exercise of the powers of the
bank and it shall be the duty of the Board
to comply with such directions.".
2-A 53855-12,100 (81/01)
